moves.label: Quick Pegasus Jab
moves.description: Fast high Pegasus jab with a tiny active window for close checks.
moves.reason: Compact bronze-cloth punch at upper-body height.

moves.label: Low Pegasus Kick
moves.description: Fast low kick with extended active time and steady recovery.
moves.reason: Short low kick sequence stays near leg height.

moves.label: Pegasus Body Punch

moves.label: Pegasus Guard Break
